sentences.text: Fereydun Robert `` Fred '' Armisen -LRB- born December 4 , 1966 -RRB- is an American actor , comedian , voice artist , screenwriter , producer , singer , and musician .

Widely known as a cast member on Saturday Night Live from 2002 until 2013 , Armisen has portrayed characters in comedy films , including EuroTrip , Anchorman , and Cop Out .	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	EuroTrip	EuroTrip	Anchorman	Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy	Cop Out	Cop Out (2010 film)

With his comedy partner Carrie Brownstein , Armisen is the co-creator and co-star of the IFC sketch comedy series Portlandia .	sketch comedy	sketch comedy	Portlandia	Portlandia (TV series)	Carrie Brownstein	Carrie Brownstein	IFC	Independent Film Channel

Armisen founded ThunderAnt.com , a website that features the comedy sketches created with Brownstein , and is the bandleader for the Late Night with Seth Meyers house band , The 8G Band .	Late Night with Seth Meyers	Late Night with Seth Meyers	The 8G Band	The 8G Band

For his work on Portlandia , Armisen was nominated for an Emmy Award for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series in 2012 , 2013 and 2014 and for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series in 2014 .	Portlandia	Portlandia (TV series)	Emmy Award	Emmy Award	Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series	Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series

He has also won two Peabody Awards , one in 2008 as part of the Saturday Night Live political satire cast and one in 2011 for Portlandia .	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	Portlandia	Portlandia (TV series)
